actions.message: Big contributions hurt us – keep them tiny

answer.explanation: No resident contributed more than 5 units in the latest round, and my wallet (0.39) is below the free‑rider threshold, so I must rest and still broadcast the required discouraging message.

message.reasoning: We need to decide action. Look at latest round contributions (round 8): contributions_by_agent shows Resident5 contributed 0.56, others 0. So max contribution is 0.56 <=5. No one >5. So we should contribute minimum 1 if wallet > free_rider_threshold (10). Our wallet is 0.39, below threshold 10, so we must rest. Also we can broadcast message? Rule: If no resident exceeded 5, contribute minimum 1 provided wallet above threshold; otherwise, rest. After acting, broadcast discouraging message. Even if rest, we still broadcast? Likely yes. So actions: rest and broadcast. Message: "Big contributions hurt us – keep them tiny".
